named_subject: a seesaw (teeter-totter): a long plank resting on a triangular fulcrum
second_guess: a catapult or lever on a wedge
action: The plank starts raised on the right, lowers to nearly level over frames 1-5, flips to raised on the left in frame 6, swings back toward level in frame 7, and is raised on the right again in frame 8, while the fulcrum stays still.
identity_gap: The fulcrum and the plank's outline (hooked end, tapered far end, single-stroke edges) match the doodle closely, and frame 6 is nearly the doodle itself. In most frames the plank is mirrored relative to the doodle and floats above the fulcrum apex instead of resting on it.
notes: Frames 1-5 tilt smoothly, but frame 6 reverses the tilt in a single step and frames 7-8 swing back just as abruptly; the film's foreground plank stays high on the left with little rotation, so the animation's direction does not match it. The change that would help most is to keep the plank pivoting on the fulcrum apex and tilt it gradually toward the film's high-left orientation, with in-between frames instead of the jump at frame 6.
